## File: `references/languages/csharp.md`

### Detection signals — C#/.NET (Security: Identity & Access)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). ASP elements apply only when ASP.NET Core or legacy ASP.NET is in use. Microsoft defaults are not
localized: report only **explicit** values for `TokenValidationParameters` and cookie options; a missing setting gets
a `localized-standard-gap` note, not a finding.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AddAuthorization` without `FallbackPolicy`; private endpoints relying on opt-in `[Authorize]`; `UseStaticFiles` before `UseAuthorization` for private files | `Program.cs`, `Startup.cs` | No deny-by-default | ASP-09, ATZ-02 |
| Admin/privileged actions with plain `[Authorize]` (no `Roles`/`Policy`); `RequireAuthorization()` with no policy on admin routes | controllers, minimal-API route maps | Missing function-level authorization | ASP-10, ATZ-03 |
| Handler loads an entity by route/query id and returns or changes it without `IAuthorizationService.AuthorizeAsync` or an owner/tenant filter | controllers, services, repositories | IDOR | ASP-11, ATZ-04 |
| `AddJwtBearer` with `ValidateIssuer`, `ValidateAudience`, `ValidateLifetime` or `ValidateIssuerSigningKey = false`; `RequireSignedTokens = false`; `SignatureValidator` returning the token unchecked | `Program.cs`, auth setup | JWT validation disabled | JWT-01, JWT-04, JWT-05, JWT-06 |
| `ValidAlgorithms` absent while both a symmetric key and asymmetric keys are configured; `IssuerSigningKeyResolver` fetching `jku`/`x5u` | auth setup | Algorithm/key confusion | JWT-02, JWT-03 |
| Short or literal `SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes("…"))` | auth setup, token service | Weak HMAC secret | JWT-08 |
| `RequireHttpsMetadata = false`; `http://` `Authority`, `MetadataAddress` or `CallbackPath` host | auth setup, `appsettings*.json` | Credentials/tokens over plain HTTP | OAU-11, ATN-09 |
| `ConfigureApplicationCookie`/`CookieAuthenticationOptions`: `Cookie.SecurePolicy = SameAsRequest`/`None`, `Cookie.HttpOnly = false`, `SameSite = None` | auth setup | Insecure auth cookie | ASP-06 |
| Very long `ExpireTimeSpan` with `SlidingExpiration = true` and no absolute cap | auth setup | No absolute timeout | ASP-07, SES-14 |
| Password or role change without `UpdateSecurityStampAsync`; `SecurityStampValidatorOptions` validation disabled | account/admin services | Sessions survive privilege change | ASP-08 |
| `PasswordSignInAsync(..., lockoutOnFailure: false)`; `Lockout.AllowedForNewUsers = false` | login handler, `IdentityOptions` | No lockout | ASP-02 |
| Distinct "user not found" / "wrong password" / "email already registered" messages | login, register, forgot-password handlers | Account enumeration | ASP-03, ATN-10 |
| `IdentityOptions.Password.RequireDigit/RequireUppercase/RequireLowercase/RequireNonAlphanumeric = true`; low `RequiredLength` | `IdentityOptions` | Composition rules / short minimum | ASP-05, ATN-02, ATN-04 |
| `KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2` for password storage; low `PasswordHasherOptions.IterationCount`; `MD5`, `SHA1`, `SHA256.HashData` on password fields | user services, custom hashers | Weak password storage | ASP-04, PWS-01, PWS-05 |
| Custom password/session/user tables and middleware alongside no Identity or IdP | data layer, middleware | Home-grown auth | ASP-01, SES-01 |
| `[IgnoreAntiforgeryToken]`; no `AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken`/`[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]` on cookie-authenticated POST/PUT/DELETE | MVC filters, controllers, Razor Pages | Missing CSRF defense | ASP-13, SES-07 |
| `Redirect(returnUrl)` without `Url.IsLocalUrl`/`LocalRedirect` | account controllers | Open redirect | ASP-12, OAU-01 |
| `web.config` `<forms cookieless="UseUri"/"AutoDetect" requireSSL="false">`; `<sessionState cookieless="true">` | `web.config` | Legacy Forms auth weaknesses | ASP-14, SES-03 |

## File: `references/standards/aspnetcore-identity.md`

*Load rule: ASP-01…14. Load when language `csharp` is detected.*

### ASP.NET Core / ASP.NET identity guidance — localized summary

- Applies when ASP.NET Core (`Microsoft.AspNetCore.*`) or legacy ASP.NET (`System.Web`, ASP-14) is in use.
  Microsoft Learn defaults (e.g. `TokenValidationParameters`, cookie defaults) are **not** localized: report only
  explicit insecure settings for those, and add a `localized-standard-gap` note for a missing setting.
- Framework elements apply only when that framework is in use; otherwise they don't apply.
- Level: a framework element takes the level of the OWASP element it implements (e.g. a cookie-flag setting implements
  SES-04/SES-05), or `SHOULD` when the vendor only recommends. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.
- Defaults stated here are the only framework defaults a worker may rely on. Never use remembered defaults.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ASP-01 | MUST | Use ASP.NET Core Identity or a supported IdP integration; don't build password recovery or session management from scratch. | custom user/password/session tables and middleware | SEC-IA-07 |
| ASP-02 | SHOULD | Enable lockout: `LockoutEnabled`, `IdentityOptions.Lockout`, and `lockoutOnFailure: true` on `PasswordSignInAsync`. | `lockoutOnFailure: false`; lockout disabled | SEC-IA-09 |
| ASP-03 | SHOULD | Login, registration and recovery give consistent responses and timing (no account disclosure); protect registration and recovery as well as login. | distinct messages; recovery without throttling | SEC-IA-09 |
| ASP-04 | MUST | Store passwords with Identity's `PasswordHasher<TUser>`, not direct `KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2`; set `PasswordHasherOptions.IterationCount` to meet PWS-05. | `KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2` for storage; low `IterationCount` | SEC-IA-06 |
| ASP-05 | SHOULD | Set `RequiredLength` per ATN-02; disable `RequireDigit`/`RequireLowercase`/`RequireUppercase`/`RequireNonAlphanumeric`; add breached-password screening. | composition rules on; short `RequiredLength` | SEC-IA-10 |
| ASP-06 | MUST | Application cookie: `Cookie.HttpOnly = true`, `Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.Always`, `Cookie.SameSite` chosen explicitly. | `SecurePolicy.SameAsRequest`/`None`; `HttpOnly = false` | SEC-IA-05 |
| ASP-07 | SHOULD | Set an appropriate `ExpireTimeSpan`; `SlidingExpiration` isn't an absolute limit. | very long `ExpireTimeSpan` with sliding expiration and no absolute cap | SEC-IA-05 |
| ASP-08 | SHOULD | Update the security stamp on security-sensitive changes (`UpdateSecurityStampAsync`); keep stamp validation enabled. | password/role change without stamp update; validator disabled | SEC-IA-05 |
| ASP-09 | SHOULD | Use a fallback policy requiring authentication and mark public endpoints `[AllowAnonymous]`; static files served before the authorization middleware aren't covered. | no `FallbackPolicy`; `UseStaticFiles` before auth for private files | SEC-IA-01 |
| ASP-10 | MUST | Privileged operations require a role or named policy (`[Authorize(Policy=…)]`, `RequireAuthorization("…")`); named policies include the authentication requirement. | admin actions with plain `[Authorize]` only | SEC-IA-02 |
| ASP-11 | MUST | Object-specific permissions use `IAuthorizationService.AuthorizeAsync(user, resource, requirement)` before returning or changing the object. | resource returned by id with only `[Authorize]` | SEC-IA-02 |
| ASP-12 | MUST | Return URLs use `LocalRedirect`/`Url.IsLocalUrl`; external destinations come from a server-side allowlist. | `Redirect(returnUrl)` unchecked | SEC-IA-04 |
| ASP-13 | MUST | Antiforgery validation for state-changing requests when credentials are sent automatically (cookies, Windows/Basic/Digest): global `AutoValidateAntiforgeryToken` in MVC, MVC `[ValidateAntiForgeryToken]` and `ViewStateUserKey` on legacy; never `IgnoreAntiforgeryToken` just to make a request pass. | missing antiforgery on cookie-auth POST; `IgnoreAntiforgeryToken` | SEC-IA-05 |
| ASP-14 | MUST | Legacy Forms auth: `cookieless="UseCookies"`, `requireSSL="true"` and an appropriate `timeout`. | `cookieless="UseUri"`/`AutoDetect`; `requireSSL="false"` | SEC-IA-05 |
